title: A Brilliant Woman. A Creative Mind. And Absolutely No Mercy for Bad Headlines. 💜
coverAlt: Head of Content at VAK Marketing
html:
We wanted to introduce the woman behind our content, so naturally, we tried to come up with something nice. Smart, ambitious, creative, talented… We had plenty of compliments ready. Then we remembered that she's also the person who reviews our content, questions our headlines and occasionally decides that an entire paragraph would be better off deleted.

So there's a good chance she'll want to edit this introduction, too. 👀

Meet Olga Kozlova, Head of Content and Communication at VAK Marketing. With a background in journalism, Olga has a particular habit of looking at every piece of content as a story that needs to be worth someone's time. A catchy headline might get people to stop scrolling, but what happens next matters considerably more. She wants facts, interesting details, credible sources and writing that sounds like a person who actually understands the subject.

At VAK MARKETING, Olga leads our content and communications efforts, working across fintech, iGaming and Web3. Her days involve developing content strategies, researching industry news, finding interesting angles for articles, reviewing copy and making sure our projects communicate clearly with the people they're trying to reach. And because a good idea doesn't always belong in a 2,000-word article, she's just as interested in visual storytelling, creative concepts and short-form content.

One thing about Olga? She has opinions. Especially when it comes to content. A headline can always be sharper. An article can usually use another interesting detail. And if a paragraph is full of impressive-sounding words but doesn't actually say anything, it probably won't survive the editing process.

That editorial instinct is particularly useful in industries where everyone seems to be promising faster payments, revolutionary technology and the next big breakthrough. Finding an original story requires curiosity, a little healthy scepticism and the willingness to ask another question when the first answer sounds suspiciously like a press release.

Olga brings all of that to our team, along with the creativity and ambition to keep experimenting with how we tell those stories.

We're happy to have her shaping the voice of  VAK Marketing.

And if this post disappears and comes back with a better headline, you'll know exactly who edited it. 😉  

About VAK Marketing

VAK Marketing is an advertising agency that has been promoting blockchain and fintech projects, crypto tokens, IT startups and Web3 ventures since 2018. The agency works with iGaming operators, platforms, PSPs and affiliate teams, as well as exchanges, wallets, DeFi and infrastructure projects in Web3, and helps founders build personal brands and visible expertise in their markets.

More at https://vakmarketing.com/.
